headline: V.S.S. Mani Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: V.S.S. Mani files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011 Regulation 10(5) with NSE. Filing signals material change in shareholding at Just Dial Limited, a major Indian business directory and classifieds platform.
implication: Regulation 10(5) disclosure triggers the acquirer's obligation to announce a full takeover bid or open offer within 60 days if the threshold (triggering level post-filing) is crossed; counsel must confirm whether this is a precursor to an open offer or strategic stake consolidation below mandatory bid levels.
detail: V.S.S. Mani submitted a Regulation 10(5) disclosure to NSE on 24 August 2026 concerning Just Dial Limited. Under SEBI (SAST) Regulations 2011, Regulation 10(5) requires disclosure when an acquirer crosses specified shareholding thresholds (typically 5%, then 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70%, 80%, 90% and 100%). The disclosure filed with the exchange is the formal notification of this material change and sets off statutory timelines for any mandatory open offer. Just Dial operates in the digital classifieds and local search vertical, making this acquisition signal material to listed equity holders.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 10(5)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure by acquirer upon crossing threshold shareholding; triggers open offer obligation if threshold crossed.
Open offer requirement and timing (within 60 days of threshold crossing); 20% of public shareholding must be acquired at highest price paid by acquirer.
Price determination mechanism; acquirer must offer minimum price per SEBI valuation formula.
Delisting of shares post-acquisition if acquirer holds 90%+ of voting capital; referenced in takeover framework.
Exchange-level continuous disclosure and corporate governance requirements for listed acquiree.
Capital gains treatment of share sale consideration received by sellers in open offer.

conditions: V.S.S. Mani must file Regulation 10(5) disclosure with NSE within 2 trading days of crossing threshold (completed 24 Aug 2026)
If acquisition crosses mandatory bid threshold (typically 25% or 26%), open offer must be announced within 6 days and completed within 60 days
Acquirer must maintain funding and regulatory clearance (CCI clearance if turnover threshold crossed under Competition Act 1998)
approvals: CCI clearance (if combined turnover of acquirer + target crosses ₹1,000 cr threshold)
FEMA clearance (if V.S.S. Mani is non-resident)

triggers.note: Disclosure requirement upon threshold crossing; forms legal basis for NSE filing and subsequent open offer timeline.
Acquirer must file with CCI within 30 days if combined turnover of acquirer + Just Dial ≥ ₹1,000 cr (likely trigger given Just Dial's size).
If V.S.S. Mani is non-resident, acquisition requires FEMA approval under Schedule 1 or 2.

firms.note: No counsel named in disclosure filing; typical for bare Reg 10(5) announcement.
